Arcing Catch.name: Arcing Catch
Arcing Catch.description: The user raises both hands and catches falling steel beams, rebar or thrown blades within a room's width in a magnetic field laced with crackling current. The arcs tack loose steel scraps together in midair so nothing showers onto the people below, and the user lowers the mass to a safe spot. The reach is half a pure magnet user's, and concrete, glass, wood and aluminum fall straight through untouched. Strain: heavy.
